cases.behavior: 扩展应用的工作区、应用与 Run 写锁可以精确诊断恢复，同时保留应用 Run 并拒绝跨应用误修复。
cases.reproduction: 创建真实应用 Run 后，分别模拟其三层写锁损坏，通过公开应用维护入口观察和修复。
cases.expected: 只有当前应用的精确令牌与明确停止确认可恢复，Run 始终一致。
cases.forbidden: 未确认删除未知锁、修复其他应用的 Run 写锁或覆盖权威状态。
cases.rootCause: Native 扩展应用也经过工作区与应用写入协调，只修复投影锁不足以覆盖实际写入路径。

tests.namePattern: repairs only an observed application or Run writer lock
requiredNames: application adaptation and SDK authority repairs only an observed application or Run writer lock and preserves the authoritative Run

cases.behavior: Bound canonical owner records avoid repeated partition body/token reads while legacy writers, corrupt records, conflicts, interrupted tokens and recovery retain their original checks.
cases.reproduction: Baseline 053 / 2999b60d. The execution report records paired public CLI timing and precise source-boundary checks; only explicitly recorded old-fail/new-pass cases establish that level of reproduction.
cases.expected: Bound canonical owner records avoid repeated partition body/token reads while legacy writers, corrupt records, conflicts, interrupted tokens and recovery retain their original checks.
cases.forbidden: Trusting cached metadata as owner content, hiding corrupt or conflicting legacy owners, losing reopen visibility or repairing ownership during a read.
cases.rootCause: Named ownership reread partition bodies and tokens. A fixed hard link now streams the actual owner bytes and verifies current file identity; replacement or unsupported identity falls back to the legacy protocol, and reads never repair metadata.
